Title: Users may be unable to access the admin center or leverage Microsoft Entra to access other Microsoft 365 services
Message:
User impact: Users may be unable to access the admin center or leverage Microsoft Entra to access other Microsoft 365 services. 

More info: Users may be unable to access their cloud PCs via the Windows app web client. 

Current status: We've identified that an issue within the Azure Front Door (AFD) service is causing intermittent access issues to Microsoft 365 admin portals leading to wider impact. We're reviewing recent changes that may be contributing to the issue and are actively working on mitigation strategies.

Scope of Impact: Any users attempting to access the Microsoft 365 admin center or leverage Microsoft Entra to access other Microsoft 365 services may be impacted.

Start time: Thursday, October 9, 2025, at 7:58 AM UTC

Next Update: Thursday, October 9, 2025, at 12:00 PM UTC
